text: I don't think Light was forced to implement these changes. Morimens was always designed to be difficult, so everything being clearable with e3 after oe and aa coming out is not something I expected to stay that way. Light also never explicitly said that madness would've been clearable with just e3 at 2:54, since I think it's pretty clear that madness isn't required content based on the rewards. That said, I'm not sure if nightmare fits under the criteria of e3 only clearable since most people do have oe or can borrow someone with oe/aa, so it's not clear if people can do it if forced to use e3 only.

author: @PolarDon
text:
I don't really have a problem with D-tide update. I'm a casual player, and i couldn't care less about leaderboard. 

From my point of view it seems strange that this game has such competitive community. I just don't see why?

Competitiveness is in itself a bad thing when applied to Morimens due the 16 dupe system. It should be obvious that the difference between 4 dupes and 16 is not negligible no matter how you look at it. That in turn makes a dilemma where whales are bored to death bcs everything is design around e3. but if you try to satisfy whales, F2P and low spenders are now the dissatisfied group. A lose-lose situation.

Now to D-tide itself. I got more rewards than the previous iteration. i didn't get all the silver but i got more. The only problem for me is w5 bcs hp inflation is just ridiculous as well as very ass design of the Catena boss itself. But w5 is the only anomaly in the current tide. 

Even nerfs are not exactly a thing i really care about despite Daff being one of
